body.name: Directional endpoint map
body.construction: For fixed \(q\in\mathbb R^K\), define \(\psi_q(\mu)=(\underline\psi_q(\mu),\overline\psi_q(\mu))\), where \(\underline\psi_q(\mu)=\inf_{\theta\in\mathcal R_{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu)}q^\top\theta\) and \(\overline\psi_q(\mu)=\sup_{\theta\in\mathcal R_{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu)}q^\top\theta\).
